stories.title: Wally and the Seaweed Wig
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!

youtube.title: Wally and the Seaweed Wig | Sunny Meadow
youtube.description: Wally's grand new hairstyle floated away from his head. Finn watched the loose seaweed wave above him. A playful adventure with a funny ending. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Wally's grand new hairstyle floated away from his head.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn watched the loose seaweed wave above him.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Please come back! My portrait is not finished!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Your hair appears to be going for a swim.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Wally wanted a splendid look for a pretend portrait.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He had found a loose ribbon of seaweed drifting by.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One fine green curl for one extremely grand whale.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I shall remember your pose and draw it afterward.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Wally balanced the loose seaweed above his forehead.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The moving water lifted it into a green loop.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I have invented a hairstyle with its own waving arm.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It is greeting the entire ocean without asking you.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Wally tried turning his head away from the current.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The loose curl swirled toward his little side fin.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now my hairstyle has become a fashionable side scarf.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It does seem uncertain which job it applied for.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Why does the seaweed move above Wally?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally held the seaweed near his head with one fin.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He tilted his enormous face into a very serious pose.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: There. A dignified whale with a dignified green curl.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: And a fin that cannot wave at its portrait artist.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn waited while Wally tried to greet him.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The seaweed floated off as soon as the fin moved.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My hair only stays while I hold it still.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Perhaps this hairstyle would prefer a different model.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Wally looked toward a clump growing beside a rock.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn pointed at their loose drifting ribbon instead.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Could that rooted seaweed stay above my head?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Let the growing seaweed stay. We have our loose piece.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Wally returned to the ribbon floating between them.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He stopped trying to make it sit on his forehead.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This curl has excellent ideas about moving around.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Perhaps its portrait needs a moving hairstyle.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn suggested posing beside the drifting seaweed.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally left his head bare and gave a grand little nod.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I can stand beside my fashionable green assistant.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Now I can remember your whole face and both fins.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Should they pull growing seaweed for a wig?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: They posed while the loose seaweed waved nearby.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally's own fins stayed free for a cheerful greeting.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Please paint my assistant's most important green curl.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I shall remember its extremely independent personality.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn described the picture he would make later.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally liked his uncovered head in the imaginary frame.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One grand whale, with seaweed beside him.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Your hairstyle is now a separate member of the portrait.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: The current carried the loose ribbon past a small rock.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally watched it settle like a very fancy hat.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It has found someone who holds still for longer.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: That rock might be the model it wanted all along.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Wally gave the newly decorated rock a polite nod.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn circled its green and remarkably wavy crown.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Your new hair suits you, Mister Very Still Rock.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It has no complaints about the styling appointment.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: The loose seaweed floated off the rock once more.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally watched it swirl away through the gentle water.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Our hairdresser has apparently resigned from both jobs.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It is opening a salon somewhere farther along.
lines.speaker: friend
